criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Transaction Issue
categories.definition: Reports of card payments being declined, failing to process, or contactless functionality not working.

categories.name: Card Management
categories.definition: Requests to order, activate, or replace a physical or virtual card, or inquiries about card delivery status.

categories.name: PIN Management
categories.definition: Requests to retrieve, set, change, or unblock a card PIN number.

categories.name: Card Security & Fraud
categories.definition: Reports of lost, stolen, or compromised cards, or unrecognized transactions requiring immediate action like freezing the card.

categories.name: Transaction Dispute
categories.definition: Reports of duplicate, incorrect, or unauthorized charges that have already posted to the account, or requests for refunds.

categories.name: Transfer Issue
categories.definition: Problems with transfers failing, being declined, or not arriving in the recipient's account as expected.

categories.name: Top-Up Issue
categories.definition: Problems with adding funds to the account, including failed, pending, or missing top-ups.

categories.name: Exchange Rate Inquiry
categories.definition: Questions or disputes regarding the exchange rates applied to currency conversions or foreign transactions.

categories.name: Fee Inquiry
categories.definition: Questions or disputes regarding fees charged for transactions, withdrawals, transfers, or card usage.

categories.name: ATM & Cash Withdrawal
categories.definition: Inquiries about ATM usage, cash withdrawals, or issues receiving the correct cash amount from an ATM.

categories.name: Account Access & Security
categories.definition: Issues logging into the app, accessing the account, or managing the account password or passcode.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Questions or issues regarding the identity verification process or source of funds checks.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Requests to update personal details, close or delete an account, or inquiries about account eligibility and age requirements.

categories.name: Top-Up Information
categories.definition: General inquiries about top-up methods, limits, supported currencies, or automatic top-up features.

categories.name: Transfer Information
categories.definition: General inquiries about transfer methods, timeframes, limits, or supported transfer types.

categories.name: Card Usage Inquiry
categories.definition: General questions about where the card is accepted, card types available, or usage limits.
